_comment: Physical parameters for tools/gen_rhodes.py. ALL VALUES ARE PRIORS (ESTIMATE) until the reference fit (IMPLEMENTATION-v3 §7) replaces them.

t60_v1._doc: sustain T60 of V1 (s) at MIDI keys, log-interpolated; flat below the first point, halving every 10 keys above the last (floor). Source: Shear 2011 tine Q (1974 Mark I), T60 = 6.908 Q/(pi f0) (research/09)

tinebar._doc: bar_cents_points: [midi, cents of the bar's own f0 relative to the tine] (Muenster & Pfeifle ISMA 2014 Table 1, research/09); k_rel coupling rel. to w_t^2 (ESTIMATE); mu bar/tine mass (ESTIMATE); tine T60 = target; bar T60 multiple (ESTIMATE)

release_t60._doc: damper-on T60 (s) by MIDI upper bound (soft targets, jRhodes sfz)

strike._doc: strike point from the clamp (m) at key 21 and key 108, linear in key (R05 W1)

bands._doc: hammer tip bands: first MIDI key of each band (A0 = position 1 of R05 W1)
bands._doc_K: felt stiffness K (N/m^p) per band, ESTIMATE; set so mid-keyboard contact is near the measured 6.42 ms average (Muenster & Pfeifle 2014); the contact simulation decides per key and velocity

tip_peak_gap_v127._doc: V1 tip peak (gap units) at v = 127: bass .. treble

pickup._doc: pole radius / gap per family; family 0 = 1/16 inch gap, family 1 = 1/32 inch gap

types._doc: band_shift, gscale, off_delta (gap), bell, eq_lo_db, eq_hi_db
